title: Parts of a plant
_map: Parts of a plant (Y1). Big idea: roots, stem, leaves and flowers each have a job. Creative: design a plant for a strange place (a cave, the desert).
_story: The robot planted a flower and wants to know what each bit is for. Ismaeel taps each part to find its job, then designs a plant for a desert.
_stepChain: a plant has parts → each part has a job: roots drink and hold, stem carries and holds up, leaves make food from sunlight, flowers make seeds → the robot thinks leaves are only decoration → design a plant for a strange place

talk.goodAnswer: they hold the plant in the ground and drink water from the soil.

talk.ask: What would a desert plant need?
talk.goodAnswer: something like long roots to find water, thick leaves or stem to store it, or spikes so animals don't eat it.

handsOn: Pull up a weed (with permission!) and find its roots, stem and leaves. Then draw a plant for a strange place, like the moon or under the sea.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: I grew a flower! But I don't know what all these bits are for. Tap each part to find out its job.

parts.label: Roots
parts.narration: Roots grow down into the soil. They hold the plant tight, and drink up water, like straws.

parts.label: Stem
parts.narration: The stem holds the plant up tall, and carries water from the roots up to the leaves.

parts.label: Leaves
parts.narration: Leaves catch sunlight, and use it to make food for the plant. That's why they spread out wide.

parts.label: Flower
parts.narration: The flower makes seeds, so new plants can grow. Its bright colours bring bees to help.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: I'm going to cut off all the leaves. They're only there to look pretty!

question.prompt: Will the plant be OK without its leaves?
question.onRight: Yes, you remembered. Leaves make the plant's food from sunlight.

0.hint: What did the leaves do with sunlight?
0.say: Leaves catch sunlight and make the plant's food. Without them, the plant would go hungry and wilt.

question.reveal: No leaves, no food. Keep the leaves!

narration.text: Now design a plant for a strange place. In a hot desert there's hardly any water. What would your plant's roots need to do? Its leaves? Draw it and tell a grown-up!

rule.text: Roots drink. Stem carries. Leaves make food. Flowers make seeds.
rule.ask: Can you say what each part of a plant does? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Roots hold the plant and drink water. The stem holds it up and carries water. Leaves make food from sunlight. Flowers make seeds.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a cactus has spikes instead of leaves. Why might that help in the desert?
bonus.reveal: Both! Spikes lose less water than big leaves, and they stop thirsty animals from eating it.
